}}'''Narasim Bhuran''' was a leader during the [[War of the Hundred Years]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Narasim Bhuran}}

==History==
Bhuran was the last ruler with the spoken ambition to seize control of all the [[Westlands]] and restore [[Artur Hawkwing's Empire]], and launched his campaign during the last ten years of the war. Bhuran's campaign was a failure. He was defeated in battle and his head ended on a pike.

It is possible that [[Andor]] played a role in his defeat.
